title: Futurama Drops First Look at Major Crossover With Cancelled Netflix Show Reunion
content: Futurama is making its big return to Hulu later this week, and to celebrate has dropped the first look at its highly anticipated crossover with long cancelled Netflix animated series.
author: ComicBook

title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Anime's New Video Unveils Cast Member Kujira
content: The staff for Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia , the television anime of Tomato Soup 's A Witch's Life in Mongol ( Tenmaku no Jādūgar ) manga, announced with its third promotional video on Sunday that Kujira will play Boraqchin, Ögedei's first wife and Empress.
author: ANN

title: Black Clover Highlights Asta With First Look at Final Manga Release
content: Black Clover is gearing up to return to shelves in Japan with its final manga release ever, and the first look at the manga finale is showing off a cool new look at Asta to help say goodbye.
author: ComicBook

title: Just Like Mona Lisa Anime's Teaser Unveils Lead Cast Member, Staff
content: The staff for the television anime of Tsumuji Yoshimura 's Just Like Mona Lisa ( Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e. ) manga revealed a teaser promotional video, lead cast member, and the main staff on Saturday. Chika Anzai is starring as Hinase.
author: ANN

title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Reveals New Trailer, Visual, and Kujira as First Empress Boraqchin
content: Science SARU’s historical anime Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia has released its third main trailer, a new special visual, and announced veteran voice actress Kujira as the latest addition to the cast. Kujira will voice Boraqchin, Ögedei’s first wife and the Great Khatun of the Mongol Empire.
author: Anime Corner

title: New Digimon Anime Confirmed for 2027 to Kick Off Major 30th Anniversary Plans
content: Digimon is officially kicking off its plans to celebrate the milestone 30th anniversary of the franchise, and has confirmed that a new anime is now in the works for a release next year.
author: ComicBook

title: Japanese Animation TV Ranking, July 20-26
content: The first episode of the new live-action series based on Tohru Fujisawa 's GTO: Great Teacher Onizuka manga aired on Fuji TV on Monday, July 20 at 10:00 p.m. and earned a 6.4% rating. The Eiga Crayon Shin-chan Chō Karei! Shakunetsu no Kasukabe Dancers anime film aired on TV Asahi on Sunday, July 26 at 10:00 a.m.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Now Streaming the Biggest Isekai Movie of 2026 Amid New Season Delay
content: The biggest Isekai movie of the year is now streaming with Crunchyroll , and it comes at the perfect time as fans are going to be missing out on the anime’s latest episode. The year has been a strong one for new anime releases thus far as fans have gotten to see new episodes of some of their favorite franchises…
author: ComicBook

title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan TV Anime Reveals October Debut, More Cast
content: Kadokawa revealed the October debut and key visual on Saturday for the television anime of storywriter Demunyan and artist Daisuki Tansan 's FX Fighter Kurumi-chan ( FX Senshi Kurumi-chan ) manga. The company also revealed a promo video for the visual.
author: ANN

title: 'Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e.' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tsumuji Yoshimura 's Seibetsu "Mona Lisa" no Kimi e. ( Just Like Mona Lisa ) manga revealed the main cast, staff, and a teaser promotional video on Saturday. Voice actress Chika Anzai ( Grand Blue ) is starring as the main character Hinase Arima.
author: MyAnimeList
